notes.TWN: WDI 沒有台灣，台灣用中央銀行國際收支統計：「二次所得－其他部門－個人移轉」加「初次所得－薪資」，定義跟 WDI 相同。2025 年收入 57 億美元、支出 133 億美元，支出大多是在台移工匯回母國的個人移轉（126 億）。

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan is not in the WDI; its figures are from the central bank’s balance of payments: personal transfers (secondary income, other sectors) plus compensation of employees (primary income), the same definition as the WDI. In 2025: received US$5.7 billion, paid US$13.3 billion, mostly personal transfers (US$12.6 billion) sent home by migrant workers in Taiwan.
